subject: Seed Sprint promo credits — eligibility & exception request
messages:
From: Maya Torres <maya@seedhaus.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Seed Sprint — short promo credits ask

Hi Sofia,

Quick one — SeedHaus is running the Seed Sprint accelerator with LaunchPad Labs next month and they asked if Redwood can provide a short-term promo allocation to support demo builds. Typical cohorts run a spike week of heavy embedding + chat traffic.

High-level ask: 30,000 token-equivalent credits to be used across a 6-week window (primarily embeddings + small LLM chat for prototypes). The program will list Redwood as a partner in the partner page and include a short blurb in the kickoff email and demo day materials.

We can move quickly if we get a sponsor form or brief MOU — can sign an agreement reflecting the partner placement. Any chance of an expedited review?

Thanks,
Maya
Program Director, SeedHaus
maya@seedhaus.com
(attachment: program_onepager.pdf)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Maya Torres <maya@seedhaus.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Seed Sprint — short promo credits ask

Thanks Maya — welcome to the program! A few quick clarifying Qs before we route for approval:

- Expected peak concurrency and whether teams will run synchronous demos (low-latency chat) or mostly offline batch embedding jobs.
- Whether any participant data will be production customer data (PII/legal considerations) or just synthetic/demo data.
- Confirmation of partner placement language (we typically request "Partner: Redwood Inference" with logo use approval).

Our standard accelerator uplift for these cohort promotions is in the $8k–$12k credits range for 4–8 weeks. 30k is above our standard scale and will require a one-off exception approval. If you can confirm usage profile and sign a sponsor form (attached), we can expedite a decision.

I attached the sponsor form for your review (accelerator_sponsor_form.pdf). If you can return it by EOD tomorrow, I'll kick off an internal exception review with Karthik and Marcus.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(attachment: accelerator_sponsor_form.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Seed Sprint — short promo credits ask

Looping in Marcus for quick decision.

Proposal: Approve a scoped exception of 15,000 token-equivalent credits for 60 days, conditional on:
- Signed sponsor form + partner placement confirmation (must include our logo approval step)
- Usage cap set in account to prevent runaway batch ingestion 
- Agreement that Redwood will be listed as partner on LaunchPad materials

Rationale: The cohort looks strategic for our early startup funnel and the marketing placement has measurable upstream value. 30k is too high relative to historical cohorts; 15k gives them enough runway for demos while protecting unit economics.

I attached the approval matrix I used for similar exceptions. If Marcus signs off here I can issue the credits as a dedicated promo code.

--
Karthik
(attachment: approval_matrix.xlsx)

Hi Maya — good news. We completed a rapid review and can offer a tailored promo package: 15,000 token-equivalent credits valid for 60 days. Terms:

- Credits to be applied to accelerator participant accounts only; no transfer to third-party production accounts.
- Trial extension window: 60 days from issuance.
- We require the signed sponsor form and a short MOU (DocuSign link below) that confirms partner placement and logo usage.

Next steps:
1) Please sign the sponsor form and the MOU: https://www.docusign.com/seed-sprint-mou
2) Confirm expected usage profile (approx % embeddings vs chat and peak concurrency).
3) Once we have documents, Karthik will issue a promo code and I will set the usage caps.

If you really need closer to 30k, we can revisit after the first 2 weeks based on usage metrics and marketing outcomes.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
